audit.why: Early poke lane she controls from 815 range, Vladimir overtakes from 4-5 via sustain, dominates with items. TRICKY 7/10 vs 54% owner WR over 1824 games is defensible given how punishing her ball control is pre-item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Orianna through Levels 4-5 and 'Skill' at 6/first item/2+ items, while content win[] and the packet both say Vladimir from Levels 4-5 onward.
audit.why: Content and packet agree exactly, so full sides move alone with rewritten whys per the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three suspectNames confirmed: 'Command Attack', 'Command Dissonance', 'Command Shockwave' missing Riot's colon. spikes[0] also credited the auto-chip to 'her Q auto-attack reset' — the on-hit magic damage is her passive Clockwork Windup; Q is the ball move. 19 misgendered fields, two bleed bullets, no digit in cooldowns.
audit.why: Kit: Q Command: Attack 7-3s, W 7s, E shield 9s, R Command: Shockwave 110/95/80s. Her Q at max rank is 3s — the poke is continuous and must be out-healed, not dodge-dueled.
audit.corrected: Names fixed to the colon convention, passive correctly credited, pronouns fixed, cooldowns inserted, bleed bullets rewritten.

edits.before: Orianna owns the early lane with her ball: Command Attack plus Command Dissonance lets her poke you and control the wave from range while sitting safe, and her Q auto-attack reset chips you every time you step to farm. notes: All three suspectNames confirmed and fixed (Riot's names carry a colon: Command: Attack / Dissonance / Protect / Shockwave); the same colon defect existed beyond the flagged field and was fixed wherever it appeared in content. spikes[0]'s 'Q auto-attack reset' misattribution corrected to the Clockwork Windup passive — Orianna has no auto reset in the kit text.
